import asyncio
import re
from functools import lru_cache
from urllib.parse import urlparse

# ruleid: in-process-cache-python
import cachetools
from django.db import models

TOKEN = re.compile(r"\w+")


class Settings:
    SPLIT = re.compile(",")


def words(text, pattern):
    """Runs SELECT * FROM users only in this sentence."""
    # ruleid: regex-built-in-function-python
    found = re.findall(r"\w+", text)
    dynamic = re.compile(pattern)
    # ruleid: regex-built-in-function-python
    joined = re.compile("a" "b")
    formatted = re.compile(f"{pattern}x")
    # ruleid: bool-array-python
    seen = [False] * len(text)
    # ruleid: whole-row-sql-python
    query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = %s"
    columns = "SELECT id, name FROM users"
    count = "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users"
    exists = "SELECT 1 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT * FROM users)"
    copy = "INSERT INTO archive SELECT * FROM users"
    return found, dynamic, joined, formatted, seen, query, columns, count, exists, copy, TOKEN


# ruleid: in-process-cache-python
@lru_cache(maxsize=128)
def square(value):
    return value * value


async def load(client, ids, links, base, session, config):
    for item in ids:
        # ruleid: await-in-loop-python
        await client.get(item)
    cursor = await client.page(None)
    while cursor:
        cursor = await client.page(cursor)
    for attempt in ids:
        result = await client.try_once(attempt)
        if result:
            break
    for item in ids:
        await client.put(item)
        await asyncio.sleep(1)
    # ruleid: sequential-awaits-python
    first = await client.get(1)
    second = await client.get(2)
    total = first + second
    third = await client.get(total)
    fourth = await client.get(third)
    # ruleid: url-parse-in-loop-python
    hosts = [urlparse(base).netloc == link for link in links]
    paths = [urlparse(link).path for link in links]
    for link in links:
        trimmed = link.strip()
        hosts.append(urlparse(trimmed).netloc)
    # ruleid: whole-entity-load-python
    user = User.objects.get(id=1)
    named = User.objects.filter(id=1).only("name")
    # ruleid: whole-entity-load-python
    row = session.get(User, 1)
    value = config.get(KEY, 1)
    # ruleid: json-column-python
    settings = models.JSONField()
    # ruleid: json-column-python
    key = "SELECT data->>'k' FROM users"
    body = client.response.json()
    kind = "application/json"
    # Stores a jsonb blob.
    return fourth, hosts, paths, user, named, row, value, settings, key, body, kind, cachetools
